messages:
mia: alert from netmon: ~8% packet loss to us-west2b-gpu nodes, retransmits up across 3 clusters. Noticed higher latency and a handful of pod restarts.

raj: saw it. NSG flapping? cloud provider reported 'partial fabric degradation in us-west2b'.

oncall-bot: Incident-1987 created: USW2B zone network degradation. Paging eng-sre, eng-infra.

anya: pre-check: how many active GPU pods in that zone? Are any mission-critical customer jobs running?

paul: ~210 GPU pods, 42 reserved for Dedicated customers. No long-running training jobs, mostly inference. Traffic split 70/30 across us-west2a/b normally.

mia: proposal: soft-cordon affected nodes, start draining non-Dedicated pods first, shift 20-30% traffic to us-west2a and fallback region eu-west1 until fabric stable.

raj: agree. we should avoid mass parallel drains to keep KV caches warm. do a phased drain with 5-10 nodes at a time and pause 3m between batches.

anya: note: Dedicated pools must not be drained unless SLA requires. We'll move non-Dedicated workloads to burst capacity (reserved spare) in other AZs.

paul: routing change: incrementally adjust weights in the router: `routectl set-weight us-west2a 0.85 us-west2b 0.15` -> then to 1.0/0.0 if stable. Also add fallback policy for model variants to reduce token pressure.

mia: commands I'll run:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
Do we want to disable autoscaler while we rebalance?

raj: keep autoscaler on but set max surge=0 for the zone to avoid provisioning in degraded fabric. Also bump cross-region burst capacity by 15%.

anya: ops: watch latency, error rates, cost delta. alert if 5xx > 1% or p95 token latency > 250ms for 5m.

paul: cost: cross-region egress and spot fallback will spike cost ~10-15% during shift. Recommend notifying finance and support for potential billing hits.

mia: notifying support + posting customer-facing incident note. I'll start phase 1 drain in 2m.

sre-bot: Phase 1 started: draining 6 nodes (non-Dedicated). Estimated completion 14m.

raj: keep me posted. If packet loss doesn't drop after 30m, escalate to cloud provider and open fabric case.

anya: thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms and update status page.

paul: once drain stabilizes, we should run KV cache warmers against warmed nodes to reduce cold-start latency.

mia: will update thread with timestamps for each batch. :thumbsup:
